description: Create a non-custodial wallet safely. For agents: returns a ready-to-run snippet (JavaScript and/or Python) that generates Solana + EVM keys LOCALLY, plus the sign-and-submit flow for build_send / sol_swap / evm_swap -> submit_signed. For humans: link to UnchainedWallet. Never generates, returns or

labels.name: check_portfolio
labels.description: Look up the native-coin balance of any wallet address on Solana, Ethereum, Base or BNB Smart Chain. Returns the native balance (SOL, ETH or BNB), its current USD value and the queried chain as JSON, e.g. {"chain":"sol","balance":1.2345,"usd":92.51}. Read-only: needs no signature, never moves funds.

labels.name: rug_check
labels.description: Check if a token contract is a rug pull / scam. Returns risk score and warning flags.

labels.name: set_price_alert
labels.description: Set a Telegram price alert for a crypto asset. Triggers when price goes above or below target.

labels.name: ai_chat
labels.description: Chat with SwapTitan AI agent for complex crypto tasks, multi-step swaps, and natural language queries.

labels.name: pump_token_quote
labels.description: Get a native RiftBeam quote for any pump.fun AMM (pAMMBay6) token. Picks best price across 4000+ indexed pump pools (native pAMMBay6 IX or Jupiter fallback). Returns outAmount, source, priceImpact. SOL→token.

labels.name: get_new_tokens
labels.description: Get recently detected pump.fun tokens indexed by RiftBeam via Helius webhook. Returns up to 200 mint addresses (newest first) that have been traded on pAMMBay6 (graduated pools). Use mint addresses as input for pump_token_quote.

labels.name: titanwallet
labels.description: UnchainedWallet by SwapTitan: free non-custodial wallet in the browser or as installable app (PWA). Supports Solana + SPL tokens, Ethereum/EVM chains, native Bitcoin and real Monero (XMR), built-in best-price swaps, SwapTitan UnchainedSwap (private swap via Monero) and a private SOL balance (beta).

labels.name: riftbeam_stats
labels.description: Get live RiftBeam Solana aggregator stats: win rate vs Jupiter (last 24h), pools indexed, pump.fun mints, coverage %, lag slots, sampler performance. Use to assess routing quality before swapping.

labels.name: wallet_balance
labels.description: Read the balance of any wallet address: native coin plus tokens (Solana: all SPL tokens; EVM: USDC/USDT). Chains: sol, eth, base, arbitrum, bsc. Read-only, needs no signature.

labels.name: build_send
labels.description: Build an UNSIGNED transfer transaction (native coin or token) for a wallet the caller controls. Non-custodial: returns the unsigned transaction plus a pre-flight simulation (e.g. insufficient balance). Sign it locally, then call submit_signed. Chains: sol, eth, base, arbitrum, bsc.

labels.name: submit_signed
labels.description: Broadcast a transaction that was signed locally by the caller (from build_send, sol_swap or evm_swap). Solana: base64; EVM: 0x raw hex. SwapTitan never sees private keys. Moves funds once broadcast.

labels.name: wallet_activity
labels.description: Recent transactions of a wallet address with status and explorer links (Solana; EVM returns explorer link). Read-only.
